title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Reviewed the single source that mentions a robotic arm vacuum, the PCMag and CNET reviews of the Roborock Saros Z70.
assumptions: No price information is provided in the sources, so price is omitted.

verdict.line: Picture a busy homeowner who wants a vacuum that can pick up small items while cleaning. The Saros Z70’s OmniGrip arm can grab objects and the unit also mops and vacuums well, making it a versatile choice. The catch: it still has issues with picking up items and software bugs.
